full_judgment: 15. Admittedly, the suit land has been recorded in S.A Khatian No. 19 in the name of Gyanda Sundari. But subsequently the suit land was taken over by the Government as per section 92 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Since, the plaintiff has completely failed to prove that Gyanda. Sundari was living in this country around 1972-73, it can be assumed that Lynda. Sundary, wife of Puma Chandra. Chowdhury left this country. Apart from this the defendant proved the suit land had been used as pond by the public at large for more than 30/40 years at least.
